chunks: And he, peace be upon him (AS), said:
"Prostrating on the clay of the grave of al-Husayn, peace be upon him (AS), gives light down to the seventh earth."

key_terms.الْأَرْضِ السَّابِعَةِ: the seventh earth, indicating the extent of illumination
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam al-Husayn ibn Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.طِينِ: clay or earth used as the surface of prostration

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of prostrating on the clay from the grave of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the special merit of performing sajdah on the clay from the grave of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام. It indicates a distinctive spiritual luminosity and virtue associated with this act of worship in the Shia tradition.
